Find inner strength and peace in our Movement in the Museum: Heart Centering Yoga session, where we practice the ancient art of yoga surrounded by fossils. Date and Time: Tuesday, May 19th from 5:45 pm to 6:30 pm. Location: Chesterfield Museum of Natural History. Classes: Two separate classes (beginner and intermediate) will be held at the same time — each led by a trained yoga instructor. The beginner class will include chairs for those who need them. Participation Fees: Museum Members: $5. Early Registration (Non-Members): $15. Day of Registration (Non-Members): $20. General Information: Participants must be 18 years or older and will be required to sign a participation agreement. Please bring your yoga mat and water as they are not provided. Register for the class online. Parking in the museum is free after 5:00 pm. Contact Information: If you have any questions, contact Grace Harrell (Education Outreach Coordinator, Chesterfield Museum of Natural History) by calling 305-349-6483.

Keep your kids learning, active, and engaged after school! Join our exciting 2026 Maple Elementary After School Program designed for kids aged 5 – 12. Schedule: Monday to Thursday, 3:00 p.m. – 6:00 p.m. Location: Maple Elementary School, 123 Maple Lane. Activities by Day: Monday: Arts & Crafts. Tuesday: Homework Assistance. Wednesday: Sports & Outdoor Games. Thursday: Music, Dance, & Drama. Program Highlights: All activities and materials are provided free of charge. The program is supervised by trained, experienced staff. Registration Deadline: April 3. Program Start Date: May 4. How to Register: Visit mapleelemschool.com and complete the online registration form. (Registration cannot be completed over the phone.)

Come to the 2026 Family Green Day and enjoy seasonal, environmentally-themed activities! Date: Tuesday, April 7. Time: 9:00 AM and 1:30 PM. *Each session lasts 2 hours and 30 minutes. Please select only one when booking. Location: Avioly Environmental Center. Tickets: Children aged 3 and over: $25. Children under 3: $12. Activities: 1. Making a toy animal with various kinds of leaves and pinecones. 2. Face painting with nature-themed designs such as butterflies and flowers. Other Information: Aimed primarily at 3-11 year olds, this event is enjoyable for the whole family! Frequently Asked Questions: 1. Do accompanying adults need tickets? – No! Adults can enter free with the purchase of a child's ticket. 2. Is there parking on site? – Yes, paid parking is available.

The Blue Ridge YMCA is proud to announce its upcoming gently used sports equipment drive, Gear Up for Good. Let's level the playing field and help more kids play sports this year! Donate Gear: July 7 – July 21. Bring your new or gently used sports equipment to the Blue Ridge YMCA, Cedar Creek Family YMCA, or Harbor Point Family YMCA. We Accept Equipment for: Baseball, Basketball, Soccer, Tennis, Swimming, Golf, Yoga, Surfing, Boxing, Bikes, Skateboards, Cheerleading. *Note: We do not accept sports clothing or swimwear. Shop the Sale: July 25 (2 PM – 5 PM). All donated sports equipment will be available for purchase at the Blue Ridge YMCA. Community members are invited to shop the sale for affordable, quality sports gear! VOLUNTEER! We are looking for volunteers to help organize donations and prepare for the sale. Volunteers must sign up on our official website.
